purpose: Current-project block resource inventory; baseline audit and review candidates only.
baseline_note: Blockstates, Dynasty block/item models and all 34 project PNGs use the immutable before snapshot. The actual puzzle_star_dial item alias was not included in that snapshot, so only this alias model was read from src and explicitly flagged. Java registration was read from current src.
minecraft_reference_note: Read-only Minecraft 1.20.1 build cache for exact parent model inheritance, default PNG dimensions/colors, and mcmeta. No assets were copied; no game or world was opened. Runtime resource packs may replace defaults.
scope_notes: Only this inventory.json and INVENTORY.md were written by this inventory subtask.
v9 delivery is confirmed by file hashes, not inferred from conversation. A review candidate is not classified as unfinished or a placeholder.
Existing approved accessories and the acacia shelf are retained; armor and equipment icons/worn textures were not redrawn or fully audited in this block inventory.
No new altar candidate or integration: final block ID, UV, and dimensions have not been handed over by the concurrent model task. Existing altar and ritual_altar assets are retained.
No Minecraft saves, instances, registration code, geometry, collision boxes, exported mod lists, or mods were changed. No in-game visual test was run.

Vanilla cube/cube_all/cube_column templates intentionally contain texture slots that only concrete child models bind. Their unbound slots are recorded separately and are not resource errors. Every concrete state model and registered item model resolves successfully.
